metadata.shuffled_scoring: Each rebuilt shuffled running rate is scored against the corresponding within-patient permuted outcomes, as in main_table_v10.py.
metadata.yardstick_c2: Observed Table 4 updated rate aligned row-wise; it is not rebuilt on the shuffled records.
metadata.patient_summary: Equal patient weighting. Shuffled summaries aggregate the per-draw equal-patient means and medians; intervals are percentiles across draws.
metadata.brier_skill: Individual skill is 1 - patient forecast Brier / patient yardstick Brier, eligible only for positive yardstick loss. Ratio skill is 1 - equal-patient mean forecast loss / equal-patient mean yardstick loss.
